# dsh-safety-ledger-check — Safety ledger check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-safety-ledger-check?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-safety-ledger-check?ref=badge)

`dsh-safety-ledger-check` checks a site safety-qualification ledger: whether the training hours reach the statutory floor, whether the training record carries the four elements the regulation requires, and whether special-operation certificates are present and still valid when the person worked.

The pack follows 住建部令第60号 (2025-12-17 公布, **2026-06-01 施行**), which repealed 建质〔2008〕75号 in its 第四十五条. Rules quoting 75号 are therefore stale, and this pack quotes none of them.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-safety-ledger-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-safety-ledger-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-safety-ledger-check: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-safety-ledger-check-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings.*

**Boundary:** this checks the ledger, not the site. It does not verify that a certificate is genuine — that needs the national quality-and-safety supervision platform — and it does not decide whether a trade falls inside the special-operation catalogue, which is published separately under 60号令第二条. A blank cell is reported as "the ledger does not record it", never as "it did not happen".

## What it answers

- Do new workers reach the 24-hour pre-job training floor, and managers the 32-hour one?
- Does each training record carry time, content, attendee and assessment result?
- Do special-operation workers have a certificate number recorded?
- Is the certificate still valid on the date the person worked?
- Did a first-time certificate holder wait out the six-month internship before working alone?

## Standards it follows

Quotations are verbatim from 中国政府网:

- 《生产经营单位安全培训规定》(令第3号) 第九条 (32/12 学时), 第十二条 (三级教育), 第十三条 (24 学时), 第二十二条 (档案四要素).
- 《建筑施工特种作业人员管理规定》(住建部令第60号) 第三条, 第十四条 (3 年有效期), 第二十条 (按证载工种作业), 第二十二条 (六个月实习).

One rule is deliberately capped at `warn`: 令第3号 第十二条 says 「加工、制造业等生产单位」, and does not name construction enterprises. The three-level induction on a building site comes from industry rules and local detail, so the pack quotes the article as it is and marks it `derived-from-principle` rather than inventing a construction-specific citation.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | all (pure ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |

## What it does

Ten rules over one flat ledger — one row per person per event. `dateGap` compares two dates with a required minimum gap, so "the certificate was still valid when the person worked" is expressed as 「有效期至 − 作业日期 ≥ 1 天」.

**One rule is not implemented, and the pack says why.** 60号令第二十条 makes 证书工种 ≠ 实际工种 equivalent to working without a certificate, penalised up to ¥100,000. The engine has no exact text-equality kind; the nearest, `sharedTerms`, compares bigrams, so 「塔式起重机司机」 and 「塔式起重机信号工」 would compare as the same trade. A false negative on a rule of that weight is worse than not checking it, so SL-009 is listed under `notImplemented` with the reason.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | `rules/safety-ledger-check.yaml` | 规则库路径 |

## Material format

One row per person per training record or certificate:

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `姓名` | Person |
| `学时` / `管理岗学时` | Pre-job hours / manager hours |
| `培训内容` / `考核结果` / `培训日期` | The record's four elements |
| `证书编号` / `证书工种` / `实操工种` | Certificate identity |
| `发证日期` / `证书有效期至` | Validity window |
| `作业日期` / `独立作业日期` | When the person worked, and when alone |

Aliases are declared in `src/model.ts`.

## Rule sources

Quotations live in `rules/evidence/clauses.md` and in the pack; `check:citations` verifies each appears verbatim.

Known limits: certificates are not verified against the national platform, the special-operation catalogue is not embedded, and only one of the ten ledgers is covered — the other nine are listed in the pack under `ledger.notCovered` and in the report.

## Troubleshooting

- **The plugin installs but the tool never appears**: check that `main` resolves to `lib/index.mjs` and that `pnpm run build` produced it.
- **`dsh plugin add` rejects the package**: the peer range covers `0.1.x` and `0.2.x`; outside it, grant an explicit exemption.
- **A rule did not run**: read the `skipped` array.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build
node ../scripts/sync-shared.mjs dsh-safety-ledger-check
```

plugins.description: DSH 桌面端插件：游戏日常代理（原神 / 崩坏3 / 星穹铁道）—设置页逐游戏开关、排班、计划任务自动执行并汇报 | DSH plugin for daily game automation
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-game-daily · 游戏日常

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

DSH 桌面端插件：把「原神 / 崩坏3 / 崩坏：星穹铁道」的每日自动化收进设置页一个面板里 —— 顶部切游戏、每游戏一个默认关闭的代理开关、按游戏配排班，保存后自动建立 Windows 计划任务，到点无人值守地跑一轮日常，跑完弹通知并（可选）开一个会话向你汇报。

## 安装

从源码安装（推荐）：先把仓库 clone 到本地任意目录，再让 Harness 的 `plugin_manager` 指向该目录（它自己完成 package 安装与 bundle 选择；**不要**手写 profile 的 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/gychen-NJU/dsh-game-daily.git
```

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <clone 下来的 dsh-game-daily 目录>
```

开发期（link 到某个 profile，改代码即时生效；改完仍需重启桌面端才会重新加载代码）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<本仓库目录>
```

装好后：设置 → 游戏日常。插件包声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`，profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 会列出 `dsh-game-daily`。

### 交给 Agent 安装（一句话）

把下面这句直接发给你的 DSH Agent：

> 帮我把 https://github.com/gychen-NJU/dsh-game-daily 装进当前 DSH 桌面端：clone 到本地目录后用 plugin_manager install_bundle 指向该目录，装完确认「设置 → 游戏日常」出现并跑一次依赖体检，缺什么按提示修好。

Agent 会自己完成 clone、`install_bundle`、确认插件已激活，并按依赖体检结果补齐 BetterGI / computer-use / 技能等外部条件。

## 面板里能做什么

- **顶部游戏页签**：原神 / 崩坏3 / 崩坏：星穹铁道 / 绝区零（后者暂停，仅占位说明）。
- **代理日常开关（默认关）**：打开后才出现排班与执行设置；改动先落在本地草稿，点「保存并应用」才写盘并重建计划任务。
- **排班**：每天时间、执行日（每天 / 指定星期）、超时、模式（真实执行 / 演练只诊断）、错过补跑、跑完开一个会话汇报、游戏路径（原神可指定 `BetterGI.exe`）。
- **依赖体检**：dsh CLI、DSH 版本、headless 运行器（含 credentials 补丁）、computer-use 插件、技能文件、坐标校准、提权助手、BetterGI、bettergi MCP。缺任何一项都给出「让 DSH 修这个」按钮：插件会新开一个 DSH 会话，把修复步骤（含备份/回读要求）交给 Harness 执行，并把界面切过去。
- **立即运行一次 / 停止 / 关闭全部代理**：立即运行走「已保存」的配置；停止会杀掉该游戏的 headless 运行进程；关闭全部代理会移除所有计划任务。
- **最近运行**：读取 `report.json`（状态、模式、步骤、证据、结论）与 stdout 尾部。

## 执行链路

```
设置页 ──POST /api/game-daily/apply──▶ 写 state.json + automation/tasks.json
                                              │
                                              └─▶ automation/game-daily-register.ps1（提权一次）
                                                     └─▶ Windows 计划任务 game-daily-<game>
                                                            每天 HH:MM 触发
                                                            │
                                                             ▼
                                             node automation/run-headless.mjs --game <id>
                                                            │  spawn
                                                            ▼
                              dsh --profile headless --patch automation/headless-overlay.yml "<prompt>"
                                                            │
                                                            ▼
                                 按技能执行（原神走 bettergi-control；崩3/星铁走 game-daily-*）
                                                            │
                                                            ▼
                                  <stateDir>/runs/<game>/<runId>/{meta.json,report.json,stdout.log,screens/}
                                                            │  插件每 60s reconcile
                                                            ▼
                                        记录历史 → Windows 通知 → （可选）开汇报会话
```

- headless 侧通过 `--patch` 叠加 overlay 注入 bettergi MCP（原神需要），并带 `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access` 实现无人值守；崩3/星铁没有 wincu 时按技能说明用提权助手（`scripts/run-step.mjs --ps`）。
- 报告是唯一判定依据：`report.json` 的 `status` 为 `success / partial / failed`；插件只认这个文件，不猜进程退出码。
- **前台守护**：每轮运行开始时，插件从 `automation/keep-foreground.ps1` 起一个 1 秒轮询的守护进程，游戏窗口被别的窗口抢走时立即拉回（四级回退：`SetForegroundWindow` → AttachThreadInput → 模拟 Alt → `SwitchToThisWindow`），结束/停止时写 `.stop` 自动退出；日志在 `<stateDir>/automation/guard-<game>.log`。面板排班卡里有「前台守护」开关（`ui.foregroundGuard`，默认开）。

## HTTP 接口（Host 侧，前缀 `/api/game-daily`）

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/state` | 全部游戏状态 + 任务摘要（计划任务信息走缓存，不阻塞） |
| GET | `/probe?games=genshin,hi` | 依赖体检结果 |
| POST | `/ui` | 保存界面偏好（如 `lastGame`、`reportSessions`） |
| POST | `/apply` | 保存排班并重建计划任务；`{dryRun:true}` 只打印将注册的动作、不落盘 |
| POST | `/disable` | 移除某游戏（或全部）计划任务并关闭开关 |
| POST | `/run` | 立即运行一次：`{game, mode:'real'|'dry'}` |
| POST | `/stop` | 停止该游戏的运行进程 |
| POST | `/run-task` | 立刻触发已注册的计划任务（由任务管理器跑，而不是插件直启） |
| POST | `/install` | 生成修复会话：`{check:'bettergi'}` 或 `{action:'fix-headless-credentials'}` |
| GET | `/runs?game=genshin` | 历史运行摘要 |
| GET | `/run?id=<runId>` | 单次运行的 report/meta/stdout 全文 |
| POST | `/reconcile` | 手动触发一次对账（平时每 60s 自动跑） |

## 数据位置

- 状态与运行产物：`$DSH_HOME/game-daily/`（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\game-daily`）
  - `state.json`（原子写）、`runs/<game>/<runId>/`、`automation/{tasks.json,game-daily-register.ps1,register-result.json,headless-overlay.yml,run-headless.log}`、`notifications.log`

## 环境变量

| 变量 | 默认 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DSH_HOME` | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh` | DSH 主目录 |
| `DSH_PROFILE` | `desktop` | 用来检查 headless / 插件的 profile 名 |
| `DSH_SKILLS_ROOT` | `%USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills` | 技能目录（game-daily 家族） |
| `DSH_GAME_DAILY_DEV` | — | `1` = 开发隔离：状态目录加 `/dev`、任务前缀 `game-daily-dev-` |
| `DSH_GAME_DAILY_STATE_DIR` | `$DSH_HOME/game-daily` | 覆盖状态目录 |
| `DSH_GAME_DAILY_TASK_PREFIX` | `game-daily-` | 覆盖计划任务名前缀 |
| `DSH_GAME_DAILY_BETTERGI_MCP` | 插件同级 `dsh-betterGI/tools/bettergi-mcp/bettergi-mcp.mjs` | bettergi MCP 服务器脚本路径 |
| `DSH_GAME_DAILY_BETTERGI` | `D:\software\BetterGI\BetterGI.exe` | BetterGI 安装位置（体检用） |

## 依赖与边界

- 原神：BetterGI（默认 `D:\software\BetterGI`，可在面板里改）+ 本机已注册的 `bettergi` MCP；BetterGI 没有 HTTP API，只能命令行/配置组驱动。
- 崩坏3 / 星铁：`game-daily` 家族技能 + 提权助手（坐标点击被拦时按技能说明改用 computer-use）。
- 没有「后台挂机」：原神必须可见且前台、16:9 ≥1920×1080；锁屏会失败。
- 注册计划任务、跑 BetterGI 需要一次 UAC；面板会在按钮旁说明。
- 账号风险由使用方式决定：官方条款把第三方软件/模拟操作列为封号理由之一，低调使用。

## 开发

```powershell
node test/smoke.mjs          # 纯 Node 冒烟（不触网、不弹 UAC）
node --check index.js        # 语法自检
```

`lib/` 全部是纯 Node 模块（无第三方依赖）；`client.js` 是 Harness 的 lazy client 工厂（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），只注册 `settings.section` 一个 slot。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 gychen-NJU

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: out-of-band progress narration for the Web UI and dsh-tui
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-progress-summary

[![test](https://github.com/tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary/actions/workflows/test.yml)

Out-of-band progress narration for DeepSeek Harness: a cheap auxiliary model turns the live
chain of thought into one short status line, shown above the composer in the Web UI and on the
dsh-tui status line.

## Where it shows

- **Web**: the row above the composer (the input dock), not the transcript's process rows.
- **dsh-tui**: the keyed status line above the prompt.
- **Switch**: Settings → General → **Show progress summary**. Turning it off cancels every
  auxiliary call and clears the TUI row immediately.
- Other knobs (model, interval, token floor, language) live on the plugin's page in Plugins.

The transcript's four work-details modes are untouched; this plugin does not add a fifth mode.

## Why out-of-band

Codex-style progress text comes from a model-side channel (`reasoning.summary` plus `commentary`
messages). DeepSeek exposes only raw `reasoning_content`, so there are two ways to approximate it:

- **Prompt nudging** (what the existing working-activity / progress-narrator plugins do): ask the
  main model to narrate each step. Cheap, but it competes with the task for output budget, and
  OpenAI's own Codex migration guide recommends removing exactly this kind of preamble prompt.
- **Out-of-band narration** (this plugin): the main model is untouched; a second, tiny request
  reads the recent reasoning and writes one line.

The cost is an extra call; the benefit is that the task never competes with its own status text.

## Trigger policy

Two layers: **free lines** update at every boundary, **model lines** fire only before a tool call.

| Trigger | Output | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Turn start (opt-in) | "Analyzing the request" | 0 |
| Every tool call (opt-in) | a line derived from the tool name and arguments | 0 |
| **Before a tool call**, with both floors met | one sentence from the auxiliary model | 1 call |
| Turn end | idle, clearing both surfaces | 0 |

The model line requires both:

1. **Time**: at least `minIntervalMs` since the last model line (default 20s).
2. **Tokens**: at least `minTokens` of new reasoning since then (default 600; `charsPerToken`
   defaults to 3, so roughly 1800 characters).

A tool call is the only trigger that starts a model line because it is the one point where the
preceding chain of thought is known to be complete: the model has committed to an action. A pause
in the stream proves nothing (network jitter, a provider that emits two tokens and stalls, ordinary
tokenization gaps), which is why there is no timer-based trigger.

Below either floor the material stays buffered and the next tool boundary re-checks. A failed call
returns the consumed characters and retries at the next boundary. Turns without tool calls get no
model line at all — a deliberate trade: rather than cut into a reasoning block, stay quiet.

The two free rows are off by default (`quickLines: false`): the dock is a summary surface, not a
second command log. The prompt also forbids naming tools, commands, or paths, because the
transcript already shows every call.

Caps: `maxPerTurn` (default 40) calls per turn, 96 output tokens per call, `effort=off`.

## Install

### From a git tag (no registry needed)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary#v0.1.0"
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add "github:tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary#v0.1.0"   # optional
```

`dsh plugin add` forwards the spec to pnpm, so any pnpm git form works:
`github:user/repo#tag`, `git+https://github.com/user/repo.git#tag`, or the plain
`https://github.com/user/repo#tag`. The tag pins the version; the package has no build step, so
pnpm clones it and installs its dependencies from the registry.

### From npm (once published)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-progress-summary
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-progress-summary   # optional: TUI
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends it to the profile's bundle
list; `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `progress-summary` row and `dsh.client` makes the Web client
load the browser half. The plugin deliberately depends on **no DSH core package**: the session
module and the record-append function come from the Loader's own module instance at runtime, so
installing it can never shadow the host's core packages with different versions.

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-progress-summary`.

### Local development (`link:`)

```bash
npm install --omit=dev
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$PWD"
```

`link:` is a development convenience: the profile holds a symlink, so a source edit plus a restart
is enough. It has no bearing on publishing.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; also the Settings toggle (live) |
| `provider` / `model` | `auto` | `auto` follows the session's own route; otherwise pin a route |
| `effort` | `off` | Reasoning effort for the auxiliary call |
| `maxTokens` | `96` | Output cap for one line |
| `timeoutMs` | `8000` | Abort a single call after this long |
| `minIntervalMs` | `20000` | Time floor between two model lines (live) |
| `minTokens` | `600` | Token floor at a tool boundary (live) |
| `charsPerToken` | `3` | Divisor used for the token estimate |
| `excerptChars` | `700` | Reasoning tail sent to the model |
| `maxLineChars` | `128` | Hard cap for the rendered line (characters) |
| `maxPerTurn` | `40` | Hard cap on auxiliary calls per turn (live) |
| `lang` | `auto` | `auto` follows the host locale; `zh` / `en` pin it |
| `publish` | `true` | Commit ignorable records so the Web UI receives lines |
| `tui` | `true` | Contribute the line to a composed TUI |
| `quickLines` | `false` | Opt into the free turn-start/per-tool lines |
| `subagents` | `false` | Narrate subagent sessions too |
| `debug` | `true` | Append a bounded diagnostics log under `~/.dsh/` |

Fields marked live are volatile: a save takes effect on the next tool boundary, without a restart.

## How each surface receives the line

- **Web**: the host commits `plugin:progress-summary/line` (an ignorable record, safe for resume),
  which folds into the `progressSummary` session projection. The browser reads it with
  `useProjection`; nothing is written to the model-visible history.
- **dsh-tui**: `ctx.tuiStatus.set('progress-summary', line)`, cleared at turn end. This path does
  not need the record at all.

Both profiles load the same package; only the available services differ.

## Implementation notes

- Records are committed from a microtask: `session/event` listeners run inside the session's own
  commit, where a second append is refused as re-entrant.
- The commit function is taken from the Loader entry for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`
  (`entry.moduleNamespace`), because path-resolved copies are separate ESM instances whose private
  `Session` brand does not match the live session objects.
- The auxiliary route defaults to the session's logged `request/header` route, so no separate
  credentials or model catalog entry is needed.
- A process that starts mid-turn (a restart while a turn is running) adopts that turn at the first
  tool boundary instead of staying silent until the next turn.

## Known limitations

- One ignorable record is committed per published line (roughly 10–20 per turn at the defaults);
  set `publish: false` to keep the log clean, at the cost of the Web line.
- Turns with no tool call produce no model line.
- The line is capped at 128 characters and rendered on at most two lines.
- A misconfigured provider/model fails silently; the UI simply has no line.

## Tests

```bash
npm test      # node --test, 35 cases
npm run check # syntax check of every runtime file
```

plugins.description: Local-first privacy shield for DeepSeek Harness: keep plaintext local, send only placeholders to the model, restore real values in the transcript.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-privacy-shield

Local-first privacy shield for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

Keep plaintext on your machine. Send only placeholders to the model. See real values again
in your transcript.

**Version 1.0.0** · zero third-party runtime dependencies · pure ESM · Node.js 18+

---

## What it does

DSH keeps two different records of a conversation:

| Surface | What it is | Who reads it |
|---|---|---|
| **Model-visible surface** | the messages the request is built from | the model (outbound to the cloud) |
| **Human-record surface** | the original committed session events | the chat UI and local session logs |

`dsh-privacy-shield` replaces sensitive text **only in the model-visible copy**, with deterministic
placeholders of the form `<LABEL_8hexdigits>`. Your local session logs, the chat interface, and
tool execution keep the real values. When the model replies, the response stream is wrapped and
placeholders are restored — including placeholders split across stream chunks — so the assistant
message is persisted and displayed with real values.

```
What you type:      Call 张三 at 13800138000 about 京A12345.
What the model      Call <PERSON_1a2b3c4d> at <PHONE_9f8e7d6c> about <PLATE_0a1b2c3d>.
  sees:
What you see        Call 张三 at 13800138000 about 京A12345.
  in the UI:
```

## Features

- **Model-visible masking only** — a defensive patch over `Session.deriveEventMessage`
  rewrites the five surfaces (system, developer, user, assistant, tool result) as the
  model-visible copy is derived; the human-record surface is never rewritten.
- **HMAC placeholders (default)** — `<LABEL_8hex>` = first 4 bytes of
  HMAC-SHA256(label, value); the key lives in a local file (`$DSH_HOME/shield/.placeholder.key`)
  and cannot be enumerated. `placeholderHash: legacy` keeps the old FNV-1a format.
- **Response restoration** — wraps `llm/stream` and restores `text-delta`, `reasoning-delta`,
  `tool-call-delta`, and `block-end` chunks, with a carry-over buffer for split placeholders.
- **Three detection families** — 28 entity types of generic PII/credentials (including social
  insurance, housing fund, student ID, medical record, IMEI, MAC; bank cards pass Luhn), plus
  Chinese-entity rules (organization, project, system, ID number, address, person) and a user
  term list with literal and `re:` regex entries.
- **Smart vocabulary** — `/shield scan-doc <path>` extracts candidate proper nouns from local
  documents (txt/md/csv/json/code/docx); `/shield learn` mines frequent unmatched fragments from
  local session logs. Candidates enter the term list only after explicit confirmation
  (`terms adopt`). `termsFile` hot-reloads on change (fs.watch).
- **Rules-pack import/export** — `/shield export` / `/shield import` carry the term list and
  entity switches between machines (`schema: dsh-shield.rules/v1`); `--encrypt <passphrase>`
  protects a pack with AES-256-GCM + scrypt (`DSH-SHIELD-ENC/v1`), `--pass` decrypts on import.
  A pack never contains the restore table; import validation rejects `vault/values/secrets`-style
  fields outright.
- **Term file** — `termsFile` points at a line-based word list (`#`/`//` comments, `@category`
  tags); merged with inline `terms`.
- **In-memory vault** — the `placeholder → value` table never touches disk and is
  LRU-bounded; it can in principle be rebuilt by re-running the detectors over the local log.
- **Outbound audit** — per-request placeholder counts and label distribution, plus a
  detector re-run over the outbound text to flag plaintext leaks. JSONL sink on by default with
  retention cleanup; `/shield audit [days]` queries, `audit export` writes CSV.
  Counts and labels only — never plaintext.
- **Web UI** — a dock status bar plus an expandable panel (Settings / Terms / Test bench /
  Audit / Candidates). Settings groups the 28 entity types by sensitivity with a search box and
  shows an "enabled x/y" counter; Terms shows category chips and sorts entries by hit count;
  the Test bench can show an opt-in placeholder ↔ value table (off by default); the diagnostics
  badge is hidden unless enabled in Settings; an `⟳ host-version` pill plus a "restart DSH" hint
  appears when the loaded UI bundle is older than the host plugin. Sensitive actions need
  `confirm`. See `docs/CLIENT-RPC-NOTES.md` for the RPC contract (11 methods).
- **Ops commands** — `/shield pause <minutes>` temporarily passes plaintext and auto-resumes;
  `/shield doctor` runs a check-up with OK/warn lines.
- **`shield_scan` tool** — a model-callable tool that reports masking statistics (counts and
  labels only).
- **Zero runtime dependencies.** Toggleable via `/shield on|off` and `/shield enforce|observe`.

> **Image note.** This plugin does not inspect image content (no OCR); images pass through
> untouched — handle sensitive images yourself. Text-like file block contents are masked.

> **Plaintext note.** Real values in your local logs are a deliberate design choice — they are
> what makes restoration possible. Disk encryption, backup handling, and access control remain
> your responsibility. See [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md).

## How it differs from other masking plugins

Several DSH plugins mask PII before it reaches the model. The design choices here:

- **Only the model-visible copy is rewritten.** Local session logs, the chat transcript, and
  tool execution keep real values — which is what makes display-layer restoration possible.
  (Plugins that also rewrite the human-record surface trade away local readability.)
- **Placeholders are HMAC-derived** with a local key file (`$DSH_HOME/shield/.placeholder.key`),
  so they are stable across sessions but cannot be enumerated or reversed by someone who only
  sees the masked text.
- **Rules packs move between machines** — term lists and entity switches export/import as JSON,
  optionally AES-256-GCM encrypted, and a pack never contains the restore table.
- **Vocabulary mining** — `scan-doc` extracts candidate proper nouns from local documents and
  `learn` mines session history; candidates take effect only after explicit confirmation.
- **Outbound audit with plaintext re-check** — every request is re-scanned for leaks; the audit
  records counts and labels only, never plaintext.

## Quick start

1. **Install** the bundle (absolute path to this directory):
   `plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<absolute path to dsh-privacy-shield>`
2. **Restart the DSH profile** — mandatory after install, upgrade, or uninstall
   (see *Known limitations*).
3. **Configure** in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the shipped `cordis.patch.yml` is a
   working example; it already defaults to `mode: enforce`).
4. **Verify**:
   - `/shield status` — mode, surfaces, counts, derive-patch status.
   - `/shield verify 张三的手机号是13800138000` — trial masking (prints masked output only).

## Rules packs (import / export)

```
/shield export [path] [--encrypt <passphrase>]   # write terms + entity switches to a pack
/shield import <path> [--pass <passphrase>] [replace confirm]
                                                 # auto-detects encrypted packs; merge (default)
                                                 # or replace the term list
/shield rules                                    # show current pack summary (counts only)
```

- Pack schema: `dsh-shield.rules/v1` — `{ schema, exportedAt, plugin, entities, terms, notes }`.
- Packs contain **terms and entity switches only** — never the restore table. Still, a term
  list is itself sensitive; handle packs at the same classification level as your word list.
- Alternatively, set `rulesPack: "<path>"` in `cordis.patch.yml` to load a pack at startup,
  or `termsFile` for a line-based word list.

## Configuration

Full reference: [docs/CONFIG.md](docs/CONFIG.md). Summary:

| Field | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` registers nothing. |
| `mode` | `enforce` | `enforce` rewrites the model-visible surface; `observe` counts only. |
| `entities` | 26 types | Enabled entity types (see *Entity types*). |
| `placeholderHash` | `hmac` | Placeholder hash: `hmac` (HMAC-SHA256, local key file) / `legacy` (FNV-1a, enumerable). |
|

# Tentacle

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Tentacle is a curated plugin bundle for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The name is the mission. DSH is a single-user local agent; Tentacle gives it arms into the world — identity and isolation for many users, IM channels for eight platforms, an expert library, expert teams, SSO, and whatever else lets it reach people, services and data. Installing one bundle turns the local agent into a multi-user, multi-channel, multi-expert workspace, and the bundle keeps growing.

Scope is open by design: **anything that helps DSH connect is a candidate package.** A new data source, tool or platform integration that makes DSH a first-class citizen somewhere is in scope; re-implementing what DSH already does is not.

**Multi-tenant by design.** Identity, authorization, and per-user isolation are the foundation everything else grows from — not an afterthought.

## Repository layout

```
packages/
  bundle/             dsh-tentacle-bundle — the one package users install
  profile/            profile templates for one-command setup
  plugin-identity/    pluggable identity (local single-user default, login gate, DID)
  plugin-crypto/      shared crypto envelopes (scrypt passwords, token fingerprints)
  plugin-gateway/     authenticating reverse proxy: one resolver→policy→forward pipe for HTTP/RPC/WS
  plugin-tenancy/     tenant/user namespaces: user directory, invites, policies, admin console
  plugin-channels/    IM channel gateway (Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, WeChat, Yuanbao, Discord)
  plugin-persona/     expert library: templates, workspaces, agent-preset selection
  plugin-teams/       expert teams: team objects, templates and channel bindings, on the official agent-team runtime
  plugin-oidc/        OIDC browser SSO login
examples/             minimal runnable profiles
tests/                e2e: install/enable chain via dsh headless profiles
```

## Status

Early development, usable end to end: every package builds and typechecks cleanly, the unit suite passes, and the e2e suite drives the full install → login → multi-tenant → channel → expert → team path against a real DSH process. APIs and package layout may still change.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的「阅读」视图插件自用维护版：过程折叠、实时思考卡片、最终回答聚焦；已脱离官方 DSHX 工具链，改用 esbuild + lightningcss 自建可复现构建。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-better-display（自用维护版）

> DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的「阅读」视图插件。本仓库是在上游
> [`aa2246740/dsh-better-display`](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-better-display)
> `v0.3.6` 基础上分叉出来的**个人自用维护版**：替换掉官方 DSHX 构建链，
> 改成可独立复现的 esbuild + lightningcss 构建，并作为本地插件长期迭代。

给 Harness 加一个 **阅读** 页签：执行时能看到步骤、思考和进度；整轮成功结束后把过程收起来，
只留下最终回答。原版「对话 / 轨迹」、输入框、模型选择、工具与审批全部保留。

---

## 一、这个仓库解决什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **阅读视图** | 独立页签，聚焦最终回答，过程按轮次折叠 |
| **思考卡片** | 实时跟随滚动、暂停/继续跟随、手动点击「展开阅读」锁定展开不被自动折叠吞入、可手动滚轮接管 |
| **思考翻译** | 设置面板选定固定模型，英文 reasoning 异步译为中文显示，每张卡片可一键切回原文；默认关闭 |
| **右上角开关组** | 自动折叠 / 自动展开 / 自动翻译 / 自动跟随，与「阅读 / 对话 / 轨迹」同一行靠右，全局生效并持久化 |
| **过程折叠** | 三档强度（不折叠 / 标准折叠 / 过程摘要），默认开启 |
| **毛玻璃** | 可选半透明背景，默认关闭 |
| **产物打开方式** | 系统应用（默认）或右侧栏预览 |
| **mcp-app 卡片** | 最终回答里的 ````mcp-app` 代码块挂成沙箱 iframe 交互卡片，可把下一轮 prompt 回填输入框 |
| **官方能力接入** | 反馈、工具详情、文件卡片、文件链接走官方 slot，不自造轮子 |

## 二、构建方式（已脱离 DSHX）

上游用官方 `dshx` 工具链构建客户端 bundle，那套工具不随 npm 发布，本机难以复现。
本仓库用 `build.mjs` 直接产出宿主可加载的产物：

```sh
npm install --legacy-peer-deps   # 官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 包互相锁版本，必须忽略 peer 冲突
npm run build                    # → lib/dsh-better-display.js + lib/client.js
npm run verify                   # 冒烟：产物满足宿主加载契约
```

`build.mjs` 做了三件上游 tsdown 配置在做的事：

1. **CSS Module 编译**：`lightningcss` 按 `[hash]_[local]` 生成作用域类名并压缩，
   输出「注入 `<style data-plugin-css>` + 导出类名映射」的模块，与官方产物结构一致。
2. **Client bundle 包装**：用 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 注册，
   模块体保持惰性，首次 materialize 才执行（CSS 注入因此也在那时发生）。
3. **平台外部化**：只把 `react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`、
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 留给宿主共享模块表，
   其余（katex、micromark 全家桶等）全部内联进 bundle。

`npm run verify` 会校验：host 侧导出 `name/inject/apply`、client 只 require 平台模块、
factory 能真正执行、8 个 CSS Module 都已注入。

## 三、接入本机 DSH（link 方式，改完即生效）

```sh
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/Users/ymj/Desktop/code/dsh-better-display
```

之后每次改完源码，只需：

```sh
npm run build        # 重新产出 lib/
```

然后**重启 `dsh web` 进程**并刷新页面（`dsh.bundle` 在开机时捕获，运行中的 Host 不会热挂载新 bundle）。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-better-display
```

> 不要手动往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里再写一条 `dsh-better-display` insert，
> 会和 `dsh.bundle` 重复挂载。

## 四、目录结构

```text
build.mjs             自建构建脚本（esbuild + lightningcss）
verify.mjs            产物冒烟校验
src/dsh-better-display.ts   Host 侧入口（webServer 路由、技能状态探测）
src/client/           浏览器侧（Reader / ReasoningCard / 折叠 / Markdown / 设置面板）
src/client/*.module.css    CSS Module，构建时编译成注入式样式
tests/                纯逻辑单测（node:test + tsx）
lib/                  构建产物，随仓库提交，便于直接安装
```

## 五、常用命令

```sh
npm run typecheck    # tsc --noEmit
npm run test         # node --import tsx/esm --test tests/*.test.ts
npm run check        # typecheck + test + build + verify
npm run build:watch  # 监听源码增量构建
```

## 六、兼容性

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer 范围 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.2.1`）
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`
- 只改展示层，不触碰 Agent 执行、SDK 与模型凭据

## 七、思考翻译

设置 → 本插件 → **把思考翻译成中文** 打开后，在下方选定一个固定模型（provider + model 列表来自宿主
`ctx.llm`）。

### 只在「你正看着它在思考」时翻译

翻译**不会**扫历史。触发条件是同时满足：

1. 你切到了这个会话（阅读视图只渲染当前激活会话，`conversation.view` 是 `only: viewId`）；
2. 这段思考**此刻仍在输出**（节点 `status === 'running'` 且它是最后一个 reasoning 段）。

子代理同理：只有你切到那个子代理的会话、且它正在打思考，才会翻。历史记录里的英文思考保持原样，
不产生任何调用——切会话不再是一次性账单。

节奏是「首次立即翻 + 每 1.6 秒节流跟进 + 收尾补一次」，所以边写边看就有中文可读；
输出结束后保留最后一次译文，不会闪回英文。

### 卡片状态

| 状态 | 按钮文案 | 卡片正文 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 未翻译 | `翻译`（仅英文卡片） | 原文（点击立即手动发起翻译） |
| 翻译中 | `正在翻译…` | 原文（不闪烁） |
| 已翻译 | `译文` | 中文译文 |
| 原文较长 | `译文（仅前半段）` | 截取设定上限字数的译文（默认 12000 字符，可设置） |
| 失败 | `翻译失败：<原因>` | 原文（点击可重试） |

点按钮随时在原文与译文之间切换（`aria-pressed` 反映当前是否在看原文）。中文占主导的思考、
短于 12 字的片段不会触发翻译，纯代码块也不会——既省钱也避免把通顺的中文重写一遍。
对于切会话之前就已经输出完成的思考，卡片右上角会显示「翻译」文字按钮，点击即可单独手动翻译，按需调用。

### 单次翻译字数上限设置

设置面板提供「单次翻译字数上限」配置，支持输入自定义数值与快捷预设按键（`6000` / `12000 (默认)` / `25000` / `50000` 字符）：
- 思考字数在上限内时全量翻译，卡片显示 `译文`；
- 超出上限时自动截取前半段翻译，卡片标记 `译文（仅前半段）`，避免过度消耗 Token 或超时；
- 点击「译文」随时切回 100% 完整原文；
- 上限写进根 store，所有会话生效并持久化。

### 附加提示词

模型选择框下方有一个「附加提示词」输入框，内容会**拼接到每次翻译的系统提示词末尾**
（标为「用户附加要求（优先遵守）」，因为模型对末尾指令遵从度更高）。留空则完全不影响默认行为。
上限 2000 字；提示词参与译文缓存键，改提示词不会误命中旧译文。

例如填「除了代码和文件路径，其余英文术语也译成中文」，`children` 就会从 `children`
变成「子元素」，而不是默认规则下的保留英文。

### 实现

翻译**只在宿主侧发起**：浏览器 POST `/better-display/translate-reasoning`，
宿主用 `ctx.llm.prepareCall` + `stream` 走一次纯文本补全，90 秒超时，客户端断开即中止。
译文按 `provider + model + 提示词散列 + 文本散列` 缓存在浏览器内存（上限 240 条），
同一段思考不会重复付费。宿主没有 LLM 服务时该接口返回 503，插件其余功能不受影响。

## 八、计划

- [x] 思考卡片接「翻译模型」：设置面板选定固定模型，把英文 reasoning 异步译为中文展示，保留原文切换
- [x] 翻译只在会话激活且思考正在输出时触发；子代理同理
- [x] 设置面板支持附加提示词，注入每次翻译调用
- [ ] 折叠动效继续对齐官方 ChatView 的滚动行为

## 九、许可

展示与 Markdown 部分来自 DeepSeek Harness（MIT），动效参考 [Transitions.dev](https://transitions.dev/)。
本仓库代码遵循 [MIT](LICENSE)。上游版权见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-router 中文 | [English](README.en.md) DeepSeek Harness（DSH）技能调度中心插件——把「全部技能/MCP 元数据常驻每个会话上下文」改为「按需检索、按需加载」的渐进披露调度。全局生效（覆盖全部会话），技能越多，节省的上下文 token 越多。 ## 功能说明 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 只读索引 | 从宿主 skills registry 与 loader 树构建统一的技能/MCP 索引；元数据签名做失效感知（签名不变则零 registry 调用） | | `capability_search` | 按任务原文检索技能/MCP，返回行式摘要 Top 5（每项约 40-60 token）；`names_only:true` 只返名字行（体积约降 60%）；同会话同查询走带签名校验的缓存 | | `capability_load` | 按名称读取技能：默认返回 300-800 token 机械精简 brief（目录树 + 各节首句），`section` 按节点名、`full:true` 读全文、`ref` 读技能引用的资源文件；MCP 项返回使用指引；调用即计数 | | 统一评分器 | bigram 字段加权相关度（name×3 / whenToUse×2 / description×1）+ 两段式漏斗（粗排 Top 20 → 精排 Top 5） | | 使用统计 | 会话×技能调用计数与漏斗（search→load→use）持久化到 `state.json`，作为预热排序依据 | | 预热集挂载 | 按近 7 天高频 + 使用画像，为每个 Bot 会话预挂 ≤5 项常用技能（含防双挂载握手、失败熔断与滞回换位），目录硬上限 20 | | 开关双模式 | 跟随宿主智能调度开关：关闭=保持宿主原生全量挂载；打开=切换到本插件的按需调度 | | 同义扩展检索 | 查询经内置中英同义组 + `synonyms` 用户词典展开后参与 bigram 检索，意译/中英混用不再漏检（v0.3.0） | | brief 抽取层 | load 默认返回 300-800 token 机械精简 brief（路线 B：目录树 + 各节首句，铺陈与代码不带入）；`full:true` 返全文；路线 A（模型五段模板抽取）待宿主 LLM 通道接入后启用 | | `capability_stats` | 只读统计出口（v0.3.1）：search→load 漏斗与转化率、预热命中率（`loadPreheated`——未经检索直接从预热目录拿走的 load 占比，预热层价值的自证数字）、per-Bot 预热集现状、近 7 天 Top 使用、熔断状态；纯读不写、不进漏斗 | | 设置栏目与总开关 | 原生设置界面新增「技能路由」栏目（v0.4.0，SIMDT 同款 settings.section 协议）：插件介绍、只读运行状态（版本/索引/预热/漏斗）与总开关——关闭即彻底停摆（工具下线 + 预热摘除 + 心跳停写，ds-bot 自动回退原生全量目录），重新打开即时生效无需重启；附微信自愿捐款说明（完全自愿，不捐款不影响任何功能） | ## 实现机制（为什么省 token） 传统做法是把所有技能的名称、描述与使用时机全量注入每个会话：技能一多，仅元数据就常驻数千 token，而绝大多数会话根本用不到它们。 本插件把同一份信息组织成四级渐进披露，token 消耗随「实际使用」递增，而不是随「技能数量」线性膨胀： 1. **目录层**——会话技能目录只保留「名称 + 一行描述」； 2. **检索层**——模型遇到任务先 `capability_search`：bigram 粗排取 Top 20，字段加权精排取 Top 5，只花几十 token 就能定位正确技能； 3. **加载层**——确需使用时 `capability_load` 才读取全文，支持按节读取；MCP 工具只返回使用指引； 4. **预热层**——高频常用技能按使用画像自动预挂到对应会话，常用路径零检索开销，低频技能留在索引里由检索兜底。 索引与统计都是只读旁路：元数据签名不变则零 registry 调用；调用计数落盘 `state.json`，重启不丢，越用越准。 ## 安装步骤 环境要求：Node.js ≥ 22（与 DSH 宿主一致），无第三方运行时依赖。 ```powershell # 在插件目录直接做语法检查与单测 npm run check npm test # 打包为 tgz 后装入 DSH profile npm pack ``` 装入 profile 的标准流程： 1. `npm pack` 得到 `dsh-skill-router-0.4.0.tgz`； 2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/` 安装该 tgz； 3. 在 profile 的 cordis 清单中加入 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明的条目（`id: skill-router` / `name: dsh-skill-router`）； 4. 重启宿主，确认 stdout 出现插件加载且无报错。 ## 使用方法 安装后插件自动向全部会话（含经典 Agent 与 Bot 团队）注册两个元工具，模型自主调用： ``` capability_search(query: "画一张生存曲线", scope: "skill") → Top 5 of 12 candidates (17 indexed): - 图表生成 [skill] — 生成统计图表与学术配图 ★0.67 [已预热] ... → Use capability_load with the exact name to read the full instructions. capability_load(name: "图表生成", section: "用法") → [skill: 图表生成] Section "用法" ... ``` 典型场景：技能/MCP 数量多、全量挂载撑大上下文时，用检索替代常驻；打开智能调度开关即切换到本插件的调度模式（常用技能自动预热挂载，其余靠检索兜底）。 ## 配置说明 | 配置项 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `home` | string | `$DSH_HOME/skill-router`（无 `DSH_HOME` 时回落 `~/.dsh/skill-router`） | 数据目录，存放 `state.json`（使用计数 + 漏斗统计）与握手信号文件 | | `synonyms` | string[][] | 内置 10 组中英高频同义对 | 追加自定义同义组（如 `[["生存曲线","km"]]`）：组内任一词出现在查询中，其余词并入检索 | cordis 配置示例： ```yaml - id: skill-router name: dsh-skill-router config: home: D:/some/path/skill-router ``` ## 贡献指南 1. 修改代码后必须通过 `npm run check` 与 `npm test`（当前 73 项单测全绿）； 2. 设计变更先改 `SPEC.md`（唯一规格依据），再动代码——评分器权重、护栏上限、brief 模板等定稿值都在 SPEC 里； 3. 提交信息用一行说明「为什么」，中文； 4. 新增行为必须带单测（`test/` 下按模块分文件，Node 内置 test runner）。 ## 许可证 Apache-2.0，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 ## 自愿捐款 如果您觉得本插件对您有帮助，欢迎微信扫码自愿请作者喝杯咖啡：

**捐款完全自愿，不捐款不影响任何功能**——本插件全部功能对所有人无条件开放，没有任何付费解锁、试用期或功能限制。详见 [DONATE.md](DONATE.md)。

plugins.description: Automatic turn-level resume for DeepSeek Harness: continues after transient model-request failures, merges provider outages into one storm, and always yields to a manual stop.DeepSeek Harness 自动续行插件：模型请求临时失败导致轮次中断后自动接着做；同一次网关故障只重试一次；手动停止永远优先。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-continue

会话因为**一次模型请求失败**而结束轮次后，自动排队一条续行提示词接着做。

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 用的 Cordis 插件。**手动停止永远优先**，永久错误不重试，同一次网关故障只买一次续行。

## 它解决什么

dsh 的 agent loop 把「一次模型请求失败」当作整个轮次的终点：

```js
// dsh-agent-loop: step() 内
if (finish.kind === 'error' || finish.kind === 'aborted') {
  const action = await this.dispatch.waterfall('agent/request-error', {...});
  if (action?.kind !== 'retry') throw new LlmError(...);   // → turn/end { kind: 'error' }
}
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry` 只负责**轮次内同一步**的重试，而且只重试提供方策略里列出的失败码。当网关把长 SSE 掐断（`MALFORMED_RESPONSE` / `STREAM_CLOSED`），或重试预算耗尽时，轮次直接死掉，会话停在 idle 等你手动打字。

本插件在**轮次边界**补上这一层。

## 与内置重试的分工

| 层 | 谁负责 | 边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 同一步内重试 | `dsh-llm-retry` + 适配器的 `retryPolicy` | `agent/request-error` |
| 跨轮次续行 | 本插件 | `session/event` 的 `turn/end` |

两层互补：先让内置重试把能救的救回来（便宜、无副作用），救不回来再由本插件续行（会多花一次上下文）。

**建议同时配置 `retryPolicy`**，否则 `MALFORMED_RESPONSE` / `STREAM_CLOSED` 这类错误根本不会进入重试，会直接落到本插件这一层，白白多花一次完整上下文。见下方[配套配置](#配套配置retrypolicy)。

## 安装

本包发布在 **npm 官方源**（`registry.npmjs.org`），公开包，**安装不需要任何 token**。

### 方式一：从 npm 安装（推荐）

让 dsh 里的模型调用 `plugin_manager` 工具：

```
install_bundle  target: @xfufu/dsh-auto-continue
```

`install_bundle` 会自己处理 pnpm 安装、写 profile 的 `package.json` 与 bundle 列表，**不要手工编辑**。

### 方式二：直接从 GitHub clone

不需要 npm 也能装，适合想改源码的人：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kemomimi12/dsh-auto-continue.git D:/plugins/dsh-auto-continue
```

```
install_bundle  target: D:/plugins/dsh-auto-continue
```

### 方式三：手工写 profile

如果不想用 `plugin_manager`，编辑你的 profile（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/`）：

1. `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加一行：

   ```json
   "@xfufu/dsh-auto-continue": "^1.0.0"
   ```

   或指向本地 clone：

   ```json
   "@xfufu/dsh-auto-continue": "link:D:/plugins/dsh-auto-continue"
   ```

2. 同一个 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加：

   ```json
   "@xfufu/dsh-auto-continue"
   ```

3. 在 profile 目录跑一次 `pnpm install`。

### 验证安装

插件行出现在 profile 里且状态为 `active` 即成功。可用 `plugin_manager` 的 `list_plugins` 查看，或直接查：

```
include:auto-continue    enabled: true    fiberPhase: active
```

再确认日志里有这一行（说明启动自检通过）：

```
auto-continue: host interfaces verified, resuming enabled
```

## 配套配置：retryPolicy

本插件只处理**跨轮次**的恢复。让内置重试先接住可重试的协议错误，才能少花上下文。在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给提供方适配器加上：

```yaml
- id: llm-deepseek
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek-api-key"
  config:
    # ... 你原有的 baseURL / models / apiKeyEnv ...
    retryPolicy:
      mode: normal
      maxRetries: 5
      retryableCodes:
        - EMPTY_RESPONSE
        - RATE_LIMIT
        - SERVER
        - TIMEOUT
        - TRANSPORT
        - MALFORMED_RESPONSE   # tool 参数 JSON 被截断
        - STREAM_CLOSED        # 流在 message_stop 之前结束
      backoff:
        initialDelayMs: 1000
        maxDelayMs: 120000     # 必须 ≥ 网关的 Retry-After，否则会放弃重试
        jitterRatio: 0.2
```

> `maxDelayMs` 小于提供方返回的 `Retry-After` 时，`normal` 模式会**直接放弃重试**。若你的网关会返回 `Retry-After: 120000`，这里就得是 `120000`。
>
> `maxRetries: 5` 是个折中：最坏退避约 31 秒；8 次则会让最后一次撞上 120 秒上限。

## 安全边界

- **手动停止永远优先。** 续行消息是立刻排进 inbox 的，不是藏在不可见的定时器里。你按停止 → `cancel()` 清空 inbox → 插件观察到消息消失并停手。
- **人类输入优先。** 你一旦发出消息，插件会把自己还排在队里的续行提示撤掉。
- **永久错误不重试。** `AUTH` / `QUOTA` / `INVALID_REQUEST` / `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` 等直接放弃。
- **有预算上限。** 每个会话有滚动窗口内的次数上限 + 连续失败上限，防止坏路由把余额烧穿。
- **故障风暴合并。** 同一错误码在时间窗内反复出现视为**一次**故障，只买一次续行（见下）。
- **不抢 goal 的活。** 会话已有 armed 的 goal 时不介入，避免和 `dsh-goal-round-driver` 打架。
- **卸载即停。** 插件 dispose 时取消所有待发续行。

## 故障风暴合并

网关整分钟不可用时，每个轮次都会以**同一个错误码**失败。若不合并，每次失败都像一个独立事件，各自买一次续行——2026-10-21 那次真实事故就是这样烧掉了 5 次。

风暴的判定：

- 相同 `code`，且距上次同码失败 < `stormWindowMs` → 视为**同一场风暴**
- 不同 code，或间隔超过 `stormWindowMs` → **新风暴**，重新计数
- 轮次正常结束、人工介入、或遇到永久错误 → 风暴关闭

一场风暴最多买 `maxResumesPerStorm` 次续行（默认 1）。

真实事故回放（5 个连续 SERVER 失败）：

```
不合并：turn 7..11 各续一次 → 5 次
合并后：turn 7 续一次，turn 8..11 停手 → 1 次
```

## 配置

写在 `cordis.patch.yml`（或直接改 profile 里 `auto-continue` 那一行）：

```yaml
- id: auto-continue
  name: '@xfufu/dsh-auto-continue'
  config:
    enabled: true
    maxResumesPerWindow: 5        # 滚动窗口内最多自动续行几次
    windowMs: 3600000             # 窗口长度（1 小时）
    maxConsecutiveFailures: 3     # 连续失败几次后彻底停手
    includeSubagents: true        # 是否也管子代理会话
    stormWindowMs: 120000         # 同码失败间隔小于它就算同一场风暴
    maxResumesPerStorm: 1         # 一场风暴最多买几次续行
```

> 这一行是可选的。不写就用代码里的默认值（与上表一致）。
>
> 注意：本插件**没有声明 `Config` schema**（原因见[实现约束](#实现约束)），所以 `plugin_manager` 的 `Config.listConfigs` 会显示 `status: absent`，这是预期行为，不影响插件工作。

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `maxResumesPerWindow` | `5` | 窗口内最多续行次数 |
| `windowMs` | `3600000` | 滚动窗口长度 |
| `maxConsecutiveFailures` | `3` | 连续失败（期间无正常结束轮次）上限 |
| `includeSubagents` | `true` | 是否处理 `origin: 'subagent'` 的会话 |
| `stormWindowMs` | `120000` | 同码失败合并为同一风暴的时间窗 |
| `maxResumesPerStorm` | `1` | 单场风暴的续行上限 |

## 四道闸门

一次失败要依次穿过，全部通过才续行：

1. **永久错误** → 直接放弃
2. **连续失败上限** `maxConsecutiveFailures`
3. **滚动预算** `maxResumesPerWindow`
4. **风暴预算** `maxResumesPerStorm`

实际续行次数取这几者的**最小值**。

## 续行提示词长什么样

进入历史的是普通 user 角色消息，`source.kind === 'auto-continue'`：

```text
<auto_continue>
The previous turn ended because a model request failed: TRANSPORT: DeepSeek Messages transport failed
This is automatic resume attempt 2. The session state above is authoritative.
Re-check the current workspace and tool results instead of assuming earlier narration is still current, then continue the task from where it stopped.
Do not repeat tool calls whose results are already in the transcript.
</auto_continue>
```

提示词刻意让模型**重新核对工作区**而不是相信之前的叙述——这正好对上「网关断流后可能有半截工具调用」的场景。

## 实现约束

本模块只 import `node:crypto`，**不 import 任何包**。原因：bundle 以 `link:` 方式安装后，ESM 从**真实路径**解析裸说明符（realpath 之后在 profile 之外），`@deepseek-ai/*` 会解析失败。所以续行消息在本地构造，config 也在本地校验，不依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`。

代价是**没有 `Config` schema**：`plugin_manager` 的配置页看不到字段，改配置直接编辑 `cordis.patch.yml`。

## 测试

```bash
npm run verify       # 全部：28 项行为 + 风暴 + 回放 + 打包校验
npm test             # 仅 28 项行为测试（含 7 项启动自检用例）
npm run test:storm   # 风暴合并效果演示
npm run test:replay  # 真实故障序列回放
npm run verify:pack  # 检查 npm 包内容（必需文件齐全、无测试文件泄漏）
```

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `test.mjs` | 28 项行为测试，用假 host 驱动真实插件逻辑 |
| `storm.mjs` | 对比有/无风暴合并：同一次故障从 5 次续行降到 1 次 |
| `replay.mjs` | 用 2026-10-21 真实会话事件序列回放决策 |
| `verify-pack.mjs` | 用 `npm pack --dry-run` 断言打包内容 |

`test.mjs` 覆盖：临时失败续行、永久错误不续行、用户中止不续行、人类输入撤回续行、连续失败上限、**模型输出不算进展**、正常结束才算进展、失败续行不重复购买、滚动预算、单风暴只买一次、不同码各自成风暴、超窗口算新风暴、子代理开关、busy 时不打扰、卸载后不再触发、**7 项启动自检**。

> 这些测试不依赖 dsh 运行时，只依赖 Node ≥ 22。

## 发布

维护者流程。推 tag 即触发 `.github/workflows/publish.yml`：

```bash
npm version patch        # 或 minor / major，自动改 package.json 并打 tag
git push --follow-tags
```

工作流会：

1. 校验 tag 与 `package.json` 的 version 一致（不一致直接失败）
2. 跑 `npm run verify`（行为测试 + 风暴 + 回放 + 打包校验）
3. `npm publish --provenance --access public` 到 `https://registry.npmjs.org`

`prepublishOnly` 会在真正发布前再跑一遍 `verify`，`prepack` 会校验包名作用域与 `repository` 是否匹配。

### 一次性准备：`NPM_TOKEN`

工作流需要仓库 secret `NPM_TOKEN`，默认的 `GITHUB_TOKEN` **不能**发布到 npm 官方源。

1. 登录 npm → **Access Tokens** → **Generate New Token** → 选 **Automation**
   （Automation 类型绕过 2FA 提示，适合 CI）
2. 复制 token
3. GitHub 仓库 → **Settings** → **Secrets and variables** → **Actions** → **New repository secret**
   - Name: `NPM_TOKEN`
   - Secret: 粘贴 token

### 本地发布（可选）

不想走 CI 时，本地也能发：

```bash
npm login          # 首次
npm publish        # prepublishOnly 会自动跑 verify
```

### 试运行

发布前可先手动跑一次不发布的校验：

> GitHub 仓库 → **Actions** → **publish** → **Run workflow** → 勾选 `dry_run`

这会走完全部校验但不执行 `npm publish`。

## 已知限制

- **只在轮次边界工作。** 它不能修复一次失败的请求本身，只能在该轮次结束后重开一轮。
- **续行会多花一次完整上下文。** 这是它排在 `retryPolicy` 之后的原因。
- **没有持久化状态。** 插件状态在内存里，dsh 重启后预算与风暴记录归零。
- **未在多个 dsh 版本上验证。** 依赖的公开接口见下方[启动自检](#启动自检)；自检能挡住接口缺失，但挡不住**语义变化**（例如 `followup` 还在、但行为改了）。
- **子代理会话默认也管。** 若子代理失败后你想让它直接结束，把 `includeSubagents` 设为 `false`。

## 兼容性

| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| Node | ≥ 22（用了 `randomUUID`、`setImmediate`） |
| dsh | 提供 `agents` / `sessions` 服务与 `session/event` 事件（当前 desktop 版本满足） |
| 权限 | 无特殊要求，纯 Host 插件，不碰文件系统 |

### 启动自检

插件激活时会**结构性地检查**它依赖的每个接口是否存在，不依赖版本号字符串。任一缺失就**记录一条 error 日志并禁用自己**，而不是装上去然后静默不工作。

检查项：

| 接口 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `agents.get(id)` | 按 session 找到 live Agent |
| `agents.list()` | 激活时枚举已有 Agent |
| `ctx.on()` / `ctx.effect()` | 注册并持有事件监听 |

plugins.description: Kiro provider for DeepSeek Harness: AWS Builder ID, IAM Identity Center, Google and GitHub sign-in, automatic token and profile-ARN refresh, live model discovery, Claude and open-weight streaming with tool calls, reasoning-effort controls, image support, and recovery from silent refusals. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-kiro

English | [中文](README.zh.md) Kiro provider for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), with multi-method Kiro login, automatic token/profile refresh, live account model discovery, Claude/open-weight streaming, tool calls, and reasoning effort controls. The bundle registers the `dsh-kiro` provider route and mounts itself when installed. No API key or manual `cordis.yml` entry is required. This is an independent integration and is not affiliated with or endorsed by AWS or Kiro. Kiro and its logo are Amazon trademarks; see [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md). > **Fork notice.** This repository is a fork of [dat-lequoc/dsh-kiro](https://github.com/dat-lequoc/dsh-kiro), itself derived from [caopu16/dsh-llm-kiro](https://github.com/caopu16/dsh-llm-kiro). Both are MIT-licensed, and both original copyright lines are kept unchanged in [LICENSE](LICENSE). Downstream work is additive — route naming, multi-account support, live model discovery, model-selection persistence, and silent-refusal recovery. [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) records the provenance, the trade-mark position, and the fact that this plugin speaks to Kiro's service under the operator's own agreement with Kiro rather than under any right this project can grant. ## Install Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer. ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:liujiesmart/dsh-kiro dsh --profile web ``` From a DeepSeek Harness source checkout, use its launcher: ```sh cd ~/deepseek-harness pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:liujiesmart/dsh-kiro pnpm dsh --profile web ``` Built `lib/` artifacts are committed, so a GitHub install does not need to execute a dependency build script.

## Features - Sign in from **Settings → Kiro** with AWS Builder ID, IAM Identity Center, Google, or GitHub. - Import a Kiro refresh token, API key, or CLIProxyAPI-compatible Microsoft external-IdP credential. - Keep several sign-ins at once — any mix of Builder ID, IAM Identity Center, Google, GitHub, imported tokens, API keys, and external-IdP credentials — and choose the active account from **Settings → Kiro**. - Sign in with the same methods from a terminal using the included `kiro-login` command. - Discover and persist the account's CodeWhisperer profile ARN so refreshed tokens keep the correct profile. - Fall back to Kiro IDE/CLI's existing `~/.aws/sso/cache` sign-in when no plugin-managed login exists. - Query Kiro's `ListAvailableModels` endpoint so the model picker reflects the signed-in account (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, and available open-weight routes). - Show the account plan, credit usage, and reset date, with a compact persistent model allowlist. - Auto-discover each model's reasoning efforts, including `none`, `xhigh`, and `max` where Kiro offers them. - Stream text, reasoning, and tool calls from Kiro's Amazon EventStream protocol. - Send images to every model whose catalog entry accepts them, which unlocks image attachments and the harness's own image-reading tool. - Support direct egress or an authenticated HTTP/HTTPS `CONNECT` proxy. - Recover from Kiro's silent refusal with a bounded narrowing ladder instead of ending the turn on the first attempt. - Hot-reload `llm-kiro` settings without restarting DSH. ## Sign in ### Web Open **Settings → Kiro** and select a method: - **AWS Builder ID** uses the standard device-code flow. - **IAM Identity Center** uses a device flow with your `https://.awsapps.com/start` URL and region. - **Google / GitHub** uses Kiro's social device flow. The page shows a one-time `XXXX-XXXX` code and an `app.kiro.dev/account/device` authorization URL while the plugin waits for completion. - **Refresh token**, **Kiro API key**, and **Microsoft external IdP JSON** validate/import an existing credential without exposing it back to the browser status API. - An import reports what it actually verified: an API key is checked against the live model catalog first, so the page can say `Credential verified · 19 models available`. A refresh token reports verification because the exchange minted a real access token; external-IdP JSON is only reshaped locally, so it says `Credentials saved` rather than claiming a check that never happened. On success the dialog closes, the pasted secret is dropped from the page, and the usage card is re-read for the account that now applies. After an OAuth login, the plugin queries `ListAvailableProfiles`, saves the selected profile ARN with its managed credential, and uses the ARN's region for inference. ### Terminal Run the installed binary through the profile: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web exec kiro-login ``` Useful options: ```sh kiro-login --region eu-central-1 kiro-login --method idc --start-url https://company.awsapps.com/start --region eu-central-1 kiro-login --method github KIRO_REFRESH_TOKEN='…' kiro-login --method refresh-token KIRO_API_KEY='…' kiro-login --method api-key kiro-login --method external-idp --credentials-file ./kiro-auth.json kiro-login --proxy http://user:pass@proxy.example:8080 kiro-login --no-open kiro-login --logout ``` Run `kiro-login --help` for all options. `KIRO_REGION`, `KIRO_PROXY_URL`, `KIRO_START_URL`, `KIRO_REFRESH_TOKEN`, and `KIRO_API_KEY` are supported environment variables. Environment variables or a protected credential file are preferable to secret command-line arguments. ## Credentials The bundled login writes only to `$DSH_HOME/storages/kiro-auth` (normally `~/.dsh/storages/kiro-auth`). Token and device-registration files are mode `0600`. **Sign out** deletes only these plugin-owned files. Managed device-flow credentials (Builder ID, Google, GitHub, and IDC) refresh through regional AWS OIDC; standalone imported refresh tokens use Kiro's desktop auth service; Microsoft external-IdP credentials refresh only against approved Microsoft login hosts. Rotated managed refresh tokens and discovered profile ARNs are written atomically. API keys are treated as long-lived and carry Kiro's required `TokenType: API_KEY` header. When managed credentials are absent, the adapter reads Kiro IDE/CLI's `~/.aws/sso/cache/kiro-auth-token.json` and its referenced client-registration file. It never deletes or overwrites Kiro-owned credentials; refreshed Kiro-owned tokens remain in memory only. Credential priority is: 1. dsh-kiro managed credential 2. Kiro IDE/CLI SSO cache ### Several accounts The plugin stores as many sign-ins as you add, and requests use the **active** one. Accounts live in `$DSH_HOME/storages/kiro-auth/accounts.json`: one atomic, owner-only document holding every credential and the current selection. - **Add account** stores another credential and uses it, which is what signing in here has always meant. Adding never overwrites an existing account — **Sign in again** re-authenticates one row instead, without moving the selection. - Each row shows its label, method, region, and credential state — *Ready*, *Refreshes on next use*, or *Needs sign-in* — with **Use** to activate it, **Sign in again** to re-authenticate that account specifically, and **Remove** to delete it. - Removing the active account while others remain hands the selection to another stored account. **Sign out all** removes every account and its device registration; the Kiro IDE/CLI fallback is untouched and applies again once nothing managed remains. - The selection is global to this credential store across sessions. A request already streaming keeps the account it started with, and a token refresh never overwrites a login that landed while it was running. - `kiro-auth-token.json` is kept in step with the active account, so the CLI and older tooling keep reading the credential actually in use. An installation that still holds only the older single-credential file is read as one imported account; the file is left exactly as it is the first time the multi-account document is written. ## Model discovery and reasoning The adapter as

plugins.description: A sleek skills panel for the DSH sidebar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-panel

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![test](https://github.com/maomaobishop/dsh-skill-panel/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/maomaobishop/dsh-skill-panel/actions/workflows/test.yml)

A **Skills** button for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) sidebar: one click lists every skill the current session can use — with a Chinese one-liner, where it comes from, and what it does. Click a row to copy its `/name` invocation.

> 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加一枚「技能」按钮：点开就是当前会话可用的全部 skill，带中文说明、来源和最近使用，点一行把 `/名字` 复制到剪贴板。

![preview](docs/preview1.png)

## 功能

|          |                                                              |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **中文说明** | 每个 skill 配一句中文解释（`lib/zh.json`），界面显示为「中文名｜一句话说明」，英文原文降为次要行   |
| **中文搜索** | 搜索框同时匹配 名称 / 中文标题 / 中文说明 / 英文描述，敲「表格」也能找到 `office-xlsx`      |
| **键盘操作** | `↑` `↓` 选择、`Enter` 复制、`Esc` 关闭；鼠标悬停同步高亮                      |
| **最近使用** | 复制过的 skill 自动置顶（最多 3 个，存 localStorage），带「最近」标记               |
| **来源可见** | 每条标注来自 `.dsh/skills`、`.agents/skills` 还是插件自带，完整路径在 hover 提示里 |
| **翻译进度** | 底部显示「已翻译/总数」，提醒你还有哪几个没写中文                                    |
| **跟随主题** | 颜色全部走 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，深浅色自动切换                       |

数据走官方 `skills/list` Remote，所以看到的目录与输入框里敲 `/` 得到的候选完全一致。

## 安装

需要 DeepSeek Harness（桌面端或 `dsh web`）+ Windows PowerShell。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/maomaobishop/dsh-skill-panel.git
cd dsh-skill-panel
.\install.ps1                 # 装进 desktop profile
.\install.ps1 -Profile web    # 或 web profile
```

脚本只做三件事：把包复制到 `<profile>\plugins\`、在 `<profile>\node_modules\` 建 junction、在 profile 的 `package.json` 里登记 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

**然后重启 DeepSeek Harness。** `bundles` 是启动期的组合，热加载只对已在运行的 entry 生效。

卸载：`.\uninstall.ps1`。

### 手动安装（不想跑脚本）

```powershell
$p = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
Copy-Item . "$p\plugins\dsh-skill-panel" -Recurse
cmd /c mklink /J "$p\node_modules\dsh-skill-panel" "$p\plugins\dsh-skill-panel"
# 然后在 $p\package.json 里：
#   dependencies 加  "dsh-skill-panel": "file:./plugins/dsh-skill-panel"
#   dsh.profile.bundles 末尾加  "dsh-skill-panel"
```

## 加中文说明

打开 `lib/zh.json`，按 skill 名加一条：

```json
{
  "skills": {
    "my-skill": { "title": "中文名", "summary": "一句话说清它干什么、什么时候该用。" }
  }
}
```

改完点面板右上角的「↻」即可生效，**不用重启**——词典由宿主路由 `GET /skill-panel/dictionary` 每次现读文件。没写中文的 skill 会退回英文描述，不会报错。

## 它是怎么工作的

| 半      | 文件              | 职责                                                                    |
| ------ | --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Host   | `lib/index.js`  | 占一条 Loader row，并提供 `GET /skill-panel/dictionary` 把 `lib/zh.json` 发给面板 |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | 在 `sidebar.footer.action` 插槽里画按钮，向上弹出浮层                               |

客户端是手写的 lazy-CJS 工厂（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`），格式与官方发布的 client bundle 相同：外层只注册工厂，模块体在首次物化时才执行，**不需要构建步骤**，改完重启即生效。

## 踩过的坑（都写进代码注释了）

1. **点开就卡死**（0.1.1）：把 store 快照放进了加载 effect 的依赖数组。失败 → 状态回退 → 依赖变化 → 再请求 → 再失败，微任务永远排不空，整个渲染进程被占满。修法：加载 effect 只依赖 `open` / `sessionId`，用 `requestedRef` 保证每次打开最多自动请求一次。
2. **`cannot get property "remote" without inject`**（0.1.2）：Cordis 只注入 `inject` 里列出的名字。访问 `ctx.remote.skills` 时，`remote` 和 `remote.skills` 两个都要声明。
3. **bundle id 必须等于包名**：不一致会自动重试一次，变成重复注册，整个 web boot 失败。

## 测试

```powershell
npm install
npm test
```

- `test/render.mjs` — 用 `react-dom/server` 渲染按钮
- `test/interact.mjs` — jsdom 真交互：打开 → 中文说明 → 中文搜索 → `↑`/`Enter` 复制 → 最近使用 → `Esc` 关闭（20 条断言）
- `test/storm.mjs` / `test/storm2.mjs` — 失败路径回归：`skills/list` 报错时一次点击只能发 1–2 次请求，不许自我重试

## License

MIT © 2026 maomaobishop
